definitions.prefix_t: Cumulative first 1/2/3 trajectories within each arm; zero-based stored trajectory converted to count
definitions.endpoint_valid: Fresh full validation including data threshold, material box, solver/constitutive and prediction replay
definitions.raw_valid: Raw step compatible flag; not independent endpoint acceptance
definitions.new_material_events: Valid endpoint material-distinct from every prior immutable success; base not counted
definitions.new_structure_events: Valid endpoint structural-distinct from every prior immutable success; base not counted
definitions.combined_material_OR_structure_reward: Original archive separated-from-all success reward; never labeled structure discovery
definitions.representatives: After-prefix active packing and its ID-ordered material/structure subpackings; includes base where selected
definitions.retention: Signed projection onto raw edit, relative to parent; not probability and may exceed [0,1]
definitions.correction_collapses: Valid endpoint; raw differs structurally from every prefix success but endpoint does not
definitions.actual_wall_seconds: Sum original trajectory wall; base validation and surrounding campaign setup excluded
